controlled_onnx_export.transformation: Unquantized FP ONNX component export; exporter loads the exact local official safetensors and tokenizer. Stateful caches are explicit graph I/O; autoregressive and one-step flow loops remain in the runtime.
controlled_onnx_export.component_equivalence: All component outputs/states passed exporter tolerance. Strict Mimi comparison differed only by max_abs=4.936009645462036e-08, mean_abs=1.2726231564859821e-08.

controlled_onnx_export.end_to_end_deterministic_equivalence: At temperature 0 solely for fidelity isolation: exact d108 source vs ONNX produced 111360 samples each, correlation 0.9999999228952958, SNR 68.119 dB, MAE 1.22614e-05, max_abs 0.000824 PCM-normalized.
